annotation.bound_parties_text: The resolution is a non-binding European Parliament resolution that only calls on and urges the Commission, Member States and stakeholders, and imposes no obligations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Instructs its President to forward this resolution to the Council and the Commission.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: European Parliament resolution of 15 January 2019 on autonomous driving in European transport (2018/2089(INI))
